lyrics_en:
Look at others stirring up giant waves of wealth
That feeling must be amazing, yeah, definitely amazing
I once dreamed of carrying a gun
Roaming the world righting wrongs
Burning with reckless desire
Unable to hold my head high
Ah, your worries weigh on you one after another
Ah, your tragedies come one after another
La la la...

You no longer want to face the blank wall
You just want to sit quietly and think
The longer the headaches last
The harder it is to hide the gloom
No matter how you hide, you'll still be brought into the light
If it's time to be sad, you'll still be sad
But what can sadness really do?
Thinking about it feels so bleak and dispiriting
It's as if I've never loved this world
And it feels the same about me
It's as if I've never loved any of this
Are you the same too?
Ah, what future is left anymore?
Ah, I've finally become a loser
Ah, stop talking, I'm helpless too
Ah, I just want to disappear into the crowd
